messages.author: 442b578d148ed4d1
messages.subject: Saddlepoint Approximation
parts:
Hey Kasper et al,

I've been working for a while with Wei Zhang who has developed methods to fit latent multiomial mark-recapture models using the saddlepoint approximation. His implementation uses a modified version of some of the TMB functions. 

We know that there has been an issue about this on github and we saw the recent message saying that the changes had been moved to the main branch. We'd like to be able to modify our code to take advantage of this, so we don't have to modify the code outside of the package. Unfortunately, we're having trouble getting the spa_gauss example to work. The compiler fails because it's unable to find the TMBad type. 

I've copied the start of the error message below and attached the completed log. Can you provide any suggestions for running this example and how to work with the new SPA features?

Many thanks in advance!

Simon


> compile("spa_gauss.cpp")
g++ -std=gnu++14 -I"/usr/share/R/include" -DNDEBUG -I"/home/sbonner/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.2/TMB/include"   -DTMB_SAFEBOUNDS -DTMB_EIGEN_DISABLE_WARNINGS -DLIB_UNLOAD=R_unload_spa_gauss  -DTMB_LIB_INIT=R_init_spa_gauss  -DCPPAD_FRAMEWORK     -fpic  -g -O2 -fdebug-prefix-map=/build/r-base-apO4Ea/r-base-4.2.0=. -fstack-protector-strong -Wformat -Werror=format-security -Wdate-time -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2  -c spa_gauss.cpp -o spa_gauss.o
spa_gauss.cpp:5:9: error: ‘TMBad’ does not name a type
    5 | typedef TMBad::ad_aug ad;
      |         ^~~~~
spa_gauss.cpp:8:10: error: ‘ad’ was not declared in this scope; did you mean ‘atomic::tiny_ad::ad’?
    8 |   vector<ad> y; // Data
      |          ^~
      |          atomic::tiny_ad::ad

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Saddlepoint Approximation
parts:
One has to use the new AD framework for this to work:

compile("spa_gauss.cpp", framework="TMBad")

messages.subject: Re: Saddlepoint Approximation

Hey Kasper,

Thanks for the quick reply and apologies for not getting back sooner. I subscribed to the thread, but never received a notification of your response.

I tried adding the framework="TMBad" argument to the example and it works -- very quickly. I noticed this has now been added to spa_gauss.R in github as well.

Much obliged!

Simon
